release_notes:
Fix: server-order placement/status-check silently fails when a supplier drops the legacy action pair

placeserverorder/getserverorder were never part of the official DHRU Fusion
API standard -- only placeimeiorder/getimeiorder are. Some suppliers that
used to support the server-order pair as a vendor extension have dropped it,
so placing or checking a server order now returns "Command Not Found" even
though the same account/credentials still work fine against the standard
action pair, and nothing on our side surfaces this as an error.

Both server-order call sites now retry once against the standard
placeimeiorder/getimeiorder action -- same request payload, same
SUCCESS/ERROR response shape -- whenever the first attempt is specifically
rejected with "Command Not Found", before giving up.
